descriptions.look_at_obj_in_light: ALWAYS load first, before any action, for any task to "look at", "examine", "inspect" or "see" an object "under"/"with"/"in the light of" a desklamp or floorlamp, e.g. "look at the alarmclock under the desklamp". Steps: find X, take it, go to lamp, use lamp.
descriptions.pick_and_place: ALWAYS load first, before any action, for plain tasks phrased "put a/some X in/on/into Y" or "move X to Y", e.g. "put a mug on the desk" (one object, no heating/cooling/cleaning words). Not for "hot/cold/clean", not "two", not lamp tasks. Search, take X, go to Y, put.
